title: Introduction to Geopolitics and Its Impact on Markets
description: A practical guide to reading geopolitical events the way markets do, built for Indian investors and finance professionals who want to understand why the Nifty gaps down on a Middle East headline or why the rupee wobbles when the US and China clash, not just react to the news. Covers the building blocks of geopolitical risk, the US-China rivalry and its supply chain fallout, energy and commodity chokepoints, and how FII flows and the RBI respond when tensions rise. Uses real events including the Russia-Ukraine war, semiconductor export controls, the 2022-23 energy shock, and India's own border tensions, with NSE, BSE, Nifty, and rupee data throughout.
